passives.name: Cinderbloom
passives.description: Your magic damage to champions gets 10-20 extra magic penetration, more the lower their current health (20 at 1000 health or less, 10 at 2500 or more). Against a champion that has a shield you always get the full 20.

effects.mult: (100 + max(0, t_mr * (1 - stat('magic_pen_percent')) - stat('magic_pen'))) / (100 + max(0, t_mr * (1 - stat('magic_pen_percent')) - stat('magic_pen') - max(clamp(10 + (2500 - t_hp) / 150.0, 10.0, 20.0), 20 * int(t_has('shield')))))
